title: RidingView
description: What the bike computer shows. Exactly these fields.

speed_kmh.description: Current speed, km/h. 0 before any GPS.

avg_speed_kmh.description: distance_km divided by ride time in hours. 0 while the ride time is 0.

distance_km.description: Distance ridden while not paused, km: the sum of the distances between successive fixes.

elevation_gain_m.description: Total climbing, metres, by the rule in TASK.md: a climb starts 3 m above the low point (counting the whole rise from it), counts every new high, and ends 3 m below its high. Never decreases.

ride_time_ms.description: Time since the first GPS fix, ms, not counting time paused.

paused.description: true between a PauseResume that pauses and the next one.
